reference.limitation: Direct 4.522s source-site sequence shows three identifiable small moving brown pieces; exact airborne count, rotation axes and blur mechanism are not identifiable from that view. Size/visibility target follows the user 8..22px requirement, not a fabricated source constant.

_derived_density.note: Reporting values derived from the active amount and volume; not a visible-particle count.

density_note: 32 particles distributed in a world volume 12 x 2 x 2.4 u (0.556 particles/u^3 before drift and occlusion); visibility target8..18 is the scene implementation, not a measured source-site count.

emitter.placement: Convert frozen camera directions to a world transform once; parent is the static world, never the camera. World-Y-up box distributes emission across depth and canopy height.

turbulence.determinism: Turbulence is enabled for the Godot 4.7 ParticleProcessMaterial path, but influence is explicitly zero: the shared wind vector and gravity form one stable swept flow, avoiding per-render-call velocity reorientation and flies. Zero temporal noise speed also removes wall-clock timing from independent A/B starts.

mesh.shape: Four opaque triangles forming a pointed, lightly folded leaf; no texture, billboarding, trails, or motion blur.

clock: speed_scale stays zero. Only MotionDirector.apply_time requests particle simulation; set_frozen(true) requests no advances. Preprocess and seed are identical in A/B.
